_note: the universal pattern object, reduced to an executable primitive. a pattern file must supply at least id, domain, trigger, operations. the registry validates against this.

fields.version: integer -> pattern version (registry may hold multiple)
fields.status: string -> candidate | experimental | validated | active | deprecated | quarantined | rejected
fields.domain: array -> pattern-forge domain codes (KNO, NET, SEC, ...)
fields.trigger: string -> the condition that fires the pattern
fields.preconditions: array -> facts that must hold before operations run
fields.operations: array -> ordered deterministic actions the runtime performs
fields.failure_modes: array -> named ways this pattern fails
fields.repair_patterns: array -> pattern ids that repair the failure modes
fields.tests: array -> named checks that validate the pattern
fields.falsifiers: array -> observations that would disprove the pattern
fields.relations: object -> relation-name -> [target ids/concepts] from the relation algebra
fields.confidence: number -> 0..1 registry confidence in the pattern
fields.scope: string -> ephemeral | task | conversation | project | user | domain | system
